overloads.semanticRole: Returns the pathname of the folder 4D currently searches for client certificate files required by Web servers (the default "ClientCertificatesFolder" folder, or a custom one set via HTTP SET CERTIFICATES FOLDER).

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): HTTP client protocol: HTTP AUTHENTICATE / HTTP SET OPTION / HTTP SET CERTIFICATES FOLDER configure per-process client state -> HTTP Get or HTTP Request issues the request and consumes that state -> HTTP GET OPTION / HTTP Get certificates folder read back the currently active state.
